title: Medication-Dispenser Compliance
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=medreminder:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(eval(if(action="dispensed",1,0))) as taken, sum(eval(if(action="scheduled",1,0))) as due by _time
| eval missed=due-taken
| where missed>0
description: Watches an automated pill dispenser and flags days when a scheduled dose was not collected.
value: For someone with memory difficulties, a missed-dose alert lets a carer step in the same day rather than weeks later.
implementation: Ingest dispenser events into `index=personal`; flag days with uncollected doses.
visualization: Table of days with missed doses.
grandmaExplanation: It watches the pill dispenser and lets you know the day a dose is missed, so you can check in.
